scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk-bundle && concurrently -n checkout,demo -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w apps/checkout" "npm run dev -w apps/demo"
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk-bundle && npm run build -w apps/checkout && npm run build -w apps/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk && npm run typecheck -w packages/products && npm run typecheck -w apps/checkout && npm run typecheck -w apps/demo
